title: Location 3 Helix Monumental

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Hey, you might just win the prize after all! Three appearances in a row.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, you might just win the prize after all! Three appearances in a row.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: We've really started something, you know. The fire is kindled. We just have to stoke the flames.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We've really started something, you know. The fire is kindled. We just have to stoke the flames.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Me and you. We're the ones that count. You've been here since the start. I won't forget that. Not ever! Thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me and you. We're the ones that count. You've been here since the start. I won't forget that. Not ever! Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I can barely remember those early days back at Hive Mall and Meridian Market. Everything seemed so small back then. So... impossible. But just look at us now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can barely remember those early days back at Hive Mall and Meridian Market. Everything seemed so small back then. So... impossible. But just look at us now.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: It's like we were kids playing in the twilight, and now a new day dawns on this city, and we wake with the bright morning light of change. Hey, do you want to take some uppers now or later? I already took all mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's like we were kids playing in the twilight, and now a new day dawns on this city, and we wake with the bright morning light of change. Hey, do you want to take some uppers now or later? I already took all mine.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Awww, friendo! I can't stand to see a bud free wheel on the stone cold. We gotta hook you up with some mind juice soon!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Awww, friendo! I can't stand to see a bud free wheel on the stone cold. We gotta hook you up with some mind juice soon!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: You gotta lighten up friendo. I'm not saying you're square, but if we checked your corners, we'd find four right angles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You gotta lighten up friendo. I'm not saying you're square, but if we checked your corners, we'd find four right angles.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I guess so bucko. It's been a long road, but you know what? We walked it! Every step of the way, you were by my side. I won't forget that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess so bucko. It's been a long road, but you know what? We walked it! Every step of the way, you were by my side. I won't forget that.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Just one more time my friend. Once more we will hammer our point home, and put up a sign for all who follow us. This is the final!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just one more time my friend. Once more we will hammer our point home, and put up a sign for all who follow us. This is the final!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Alright, it's the dawning of the night, and we need to raise a new type of light. A neon sign driven into the heart of Nivalis like a stake, that beats with the heart of the people. And it glows in the darkness baby! It glows...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, it's the dawning of the night, and we need to raise a new type of light. A neon sign driven into the heart of Nivalis like a stake, that beats with the heart of the people. And it glows in the darkness baby! It glows...

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: SOON MY SPEECHES WILL FALL SILENT, BUT YOUR VOICES WILL FILL THE VOID. MY TOUR, THOUGH INSPIRING, EXCITING AND OUTRAGEOUSLY ENTERTAINING, CANNOT GO ON FOR EVER. MY SINGLE VOICE WILL BE REPLACED WITH A CHORUS.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: SOON MY SPEECHES WILL FALL SILENT, BUT YOUR VOICES WILL FILL THE VOID. MY TOUR, THOUGH INSPIRING, EXCITING AND OUTRAGEOUSLY ENTERTAINING, CANNOT GO ON FOR EVER. MY SINGLE VOICE WILL BE REPLACED WITH A CHORUS.
...that sounds really bad.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Alright, look, I got an idea. I don't have the prize with me right now, but if you come back and find me in a few days, we can grab a drink, reminisce about the old days, and I'll hook you up with your prize, OK?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, look, I got an idea. I don't have the prize with me right now, but if you come back and find me in a few days, we can grab a drink, reminisce about the old days, and I'll hook you up with your prize, OK?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR SUPPORT THROUGH THIS WHOLE TOUR. I DON'T KNOW WHAT'S IN STORE FOR ME NEXT... BUT I DO KNOW YOUR FATE. THE FATE OF ALL NIVALI. FREEDOM. EMANCIPATION. HOPE!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR SUPPORT THROUGH THIS WHOLE TOUR. I DON'T KNOW WHAT'S IN STORE FOR ME NEXT... BUT I DO KNOW YOUR FATE. THE FATE OF ALL NIVALI. FREEDOM. EMANCIPATION. HOPE!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: COMPANIONS! AS OUR STRUGGLE NEARS ITS END, REMEMBER, THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE THE DAWN.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: COMPANIONS! AS OUR STRUGGLE NEARS ITS END, REMEMBER, THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE THE DAWN.
DAWN!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ACTUALLY THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE TOTAL DARKNESS!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ACTUALLY THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE TOTAL DARKNESS!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: ACTUALLY THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE TOTAL DARKNESS!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: ACTUALLY THE LIGHT IS FAINTEST RIGHT BEFORE TOTAL DARKNESS!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: PEOPLE OF HELIX MONUMENTAL, IT'S TIME TO FINALLY ACKNOWLEDGE THE TRUTH WE ALL KNOW IN OUR HEARTS. THIS CORPORATE DICTATORSHIP MUST END!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: PEOPLE OF HELIX MONUMENTAL, IT'S TIME TO FINALLY ACKNOWLEDGE THE TRUTH WE ALL KNOW IN OUR HEARTS. THIS CORPORATE DICTATORSHIP MUST END!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Come on! Is that correction really necessary?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on! Is that correction really necessary?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Great. Until then... I gotta catch some Z's. I haven't slept in a week.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great. Until then... I gotta catch some Z's. I haven't slept in a week.
Hi Olive.
Yeah...

nodes.text: There's still no people here Olive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's still no people here Olive.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's still no people here Olive.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's still no people here Olive.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome.
Yeah, look at us now.
I wish I had some.
Is that a good idea?
No problem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this really the end of the tour?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this really the end of the tour?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is this really the end of the tour?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is this really the end of the tour?

nodes.text: Are we doing the shouting thing again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are we doing the shouting thing again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are we doing the shouting thing again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are we doing the shouting thing again?

A CHORUS!
FILL MY VOID!
Uhhh, right.
HOPE!
FREEDOM!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: WE SHOULD ALL BE PAID MORE!

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: WE SHOULD ALL BE PAID MORE!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...That was only a few days ago.

TIME TO START OVER!

nodes.text: I will remind you if you do.
